priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect at all times.
Use Evocation if mana is below 10% and your major cooldowns are not active.
Cast Arcane Surge as your primary cooldown, ideally at 4 Arcane Charges.
Cast Touch of the Magi immediately after Arcane Surge, or on cooldown if Arcane Surge has more than 30 seconds remaining.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities during your Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi windows.
While the Arcane Soul buff is active (immediately following Arcane Surge), prioritize casting Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges.
Cast Arcane Barrage if you reach 25 stacks of Arcane Salvo to consume the proc.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges right before the Touch of the Magi debuff expires on the target.
Cast Arcane Missiles when Clearcasting is active, prioritizing its use during the Touch of the Magi window.
Cast Arcane Missiles with Clearcasting if you are about to cap at 3 stacks of Clearcasting.
Use Arcane Orb to generate charges if you have 0 or 1 Arcane Charges.
Use Presence of Mind on cooldown to cast instant Arcane Blasts if you have fewer than 2 Arcane Charges.
Cast Arcane Blast as your primary filler to build Arcane Charges and spend mana.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges to reset your charges when outside of your main cooldown windows or to conserve mana.
